preconditions.description: The input tree is a non-empty binary search tree.

preconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val < node.val for node in traverse_inorder(root))
preconditions.description: The left subtree of every node contains only nodes with keys less than the node's key.

preconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val > node.val for node in traverse_inorder(root))
preconditions.description: The right subtree of every node contains only nodes with keys greater than the node's key.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == sum(n.val for n in traverse_inorder(root) if n.val > node.val) for node in traverse_inorder(root))
postconditions.description: Each node's value is replaced with the sum of all node values greater than the node's value in the original tree.
